name: hx1-failed-walk-early-reject
description: Sol HX1 r1 R1-3: C4's parent B3 descends from two failed blocks (B1, B2), so AcceptBlockHeader's m_failed_blocks walk would mark by address; but C4's proof of work fails, CheckBlockHeader rejects it first (invalid-header/high-hash, nothing written); the run is marked possibly address-sensitive, but it is the same under every perturbed heap, so it is kept with Core's verdict (DEC-172)
